generator.params.note: Hand-set from photographs of open-grown trees: a broad, dense, rounded crown about as wide as it is tall; a short trunk that leans and divides low into three stems; opposite buds; leaves on long petioles about 0.3 m across, and leaf area per card matched to the drawn leaf. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough open-grown sizes from general knowledge of the species. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs. Leaf: five deep, sparsely toothed lobes on a long petiole. Bark: shallow twisting ridges, a buttressed base and moss on the upper side of thick limbs, as on coastal trees.

sources.title: Runions, Lane and Prusinkiewicz 2007, Modeling trees with a space colonization algorithm (method only)
Pałubicki et al. 2009, Self-organizing tree models for image synthesis (method only)
